# JavaScript Files Analysis — Checklist

Expert per-attack **test-case matrix** for JavaScript Files Analysis — in testing order, impact-first. All columns preserved (where to inject, steps, expected, payload, impact, severity, CVSS, tools, refs).

*11 test cases · spreadsheet grid — scroll sideways for all 12 columns.*

Pull every LIVE bundle + dynamically-loaded chunk (load all routes / read the webpack chunk manifest).<br>2. Capture inline scripts, service workers, runtime config (/config.js, /env.js, manifest.json).<br>3. Pull HISTORICAL JS (gau + waybackurls) - old bundles hold rotated-but-live keys &amp; removed endpoints.<br>4. REQUIRE: an attacker-usable artifact - live/privileged secret, firing sink, or reachable unauth endpoint. | Only attacker-usable, validated artifacts survive. | <code>AIza web key = public ; unvalidated match = FP ; endpoint list alone = not a bug</code> | Protects credibility; JS analysis is dense with public-key / unvalidated-match false positives. | Info | 0.0 (N/A) | manual | CWE-798; PortSwigger Research: JS analysis; Tomnomnom / jsluice |
